sectors.note:
**TL;DR:** Defensive and energy leadership dominates as Energy cements the top spot across all timeframes, while Communication Services deteriorates further into the market basement.

Energy continues its persistent dominance as the sole sustained leader across 1-, 3-, and 6-month horizons, supported by all-green performance alongside Healthcare and Consumer Defensive. Market breadth remains tightly concentrated, with only 3 of 11 sectors holding positive returns across every timeframe from weekly to year-to-date.

Cyclical and growth pockets are actively fading. Communication Services dropped 2 spots over the past 5 sessions to rank 11th with a market-low momentum score of 0.083, joined in the bottom tier by Basic Materials and Financials. Minor rank improvements in Consumer Cyclical, Real Estate, and Utilities represent slight positioning adjustments rather than broad-based trend reversals.

## Strength
- **Narrow Breadth:** Only 3 of 11 sectors are all-green across week, month, quarter, half, and YTD: Energy (0.933), Healthcare (0.817), and Consumer Defensive (0.683).
- **Persistent Outperformance:** Energy remains the only sector exhibiting sustained strength, holding top-3 rank status across 1-, 3-, and 6-month periods.
- **Defensive Anchors:** Healthcare advanced +1 spot over the last 5 sessions to rank 4, pairing with Consumer Defensive (rank 3) to form a robust non-cyclical bid.

## Movers & Momentum
- **Momentum Leaders:** Energy leads the broader market at 0.933 momentum (rank 1), followed by Healthcare (0.817), Consumer Defensive (0.683), and Technology (0.683, rank 2).
- **Biggest Sliders:** Communication Services slipped -2 spots over 5 sessions to fall to rank 11 with the lowest momentum in the market (0.083).
- **Secondary Decliners:** Basic Materials lost -1 spot to rank 5 (momentum 0.367), while Financials declined -1 spot to rank 8 (momentum 0.483).
- **Short-Term Advancers:** Consumer Cyclical (rank 10, momentum 0.317), Utilities (rank 9, momentum 0.350), and Real Estate (rank 7, momentum 0.450) each gained +1 rank position over the last 5 sessions.

## Divergences
- **Communication Breakdown:** Communication Services has completely decoupled to the downside, sitting isolated at rank 11 with a 0.083 momentum score, well below the next-weakest sector, Consumer Cyclical (0.317).
- **Low-Momentum Rank Gains:** The 5-day rank advances in Consumer Cyclical (+1 to rank 10) and Utilities (+1 to rank 9) diverge from their underlying trends, as both remain entrenched among the bottom four overall momentum laggards.

rotation_phase.reasoning: Traditional safe-haven sectors Healthcare and Consumer Defensive are broadly leading alongside Energy, while cyclical sectors like Financials and Industrials are lagging.

industries.note:
**TL;DR:** Energy and select business services dominate sustained leadership, while precious metals and industrials face sharp short-term rank deterioration.

Market leadership remains heavily concentrated in traditional energy, with Oil & Gas Integrated (momentum 0.889) and Oil & Gas E&P (momentum 0.886) leading broad momentum alongside REIT - Hotel & Motel (momentum 0.875). Overall breadth shows 25 of 144 groups holding all-green profiles across all standard timeframes, supported by sustained defensive strength in areas like Waste Management and Health Information Services.

Rotation is actively underway toward commercial services and select real estate pockets, with Rental & Leasing Services gaining 22 spots (rank 40) and Security & Protection Services advancing 19 spots (rank 56). Conversely, aggressive fading is hitting metals and tech-adjacent spaces, led by severe 5-session drops in Metal Fabrication (-43 spots) and Silver (-34 spots), while Advertising Agencies (momentum 0.052) and Solar (0.083) remain firmly at the bottom of the momentum curve.

## Strength
- **Pervasive Energy Leadership:** Oil & Gas Integrated (momentum 0.889, rank_ytd 4), Oil & Gas E&P (momentum 0.886, rank_ytd 7), and Oil & Gas Refining & Marketing (momentum 0.872, rank_ytd 1) hold top ranks across 1-, 3-, and 6-month windows.
- **Resilient All-Green Cohort:** 25 of 144 groups maintain positive returns across week, month, quarter, half, and YTD periods, including Staffing & Employment Services (momentum 0.87) and Marine Shipping (momentum 0.82).
- **Defensive Compounders:** Waste Management (momentum 0.79) and Health Information Services (momentum 0.80) continue to register sustained multi-month strength within the top 36 ranks.

## Movers & Momentum
- **Top Weekly Advancers:** Rental & Leasing Services surged 22 spots to rank 40 (momentum 0.65), while Security & Protection Services gained 19 spots to rank 56 (momentum 0.69).
- **Severe Short-Term Reversals:** Metal Fabrication plummeted 43 spots to rank 86 (momentum 0.20), Silver dropped 34 spots to rank 80 (momentum 0.36), and Biotechnology fell 27 spots to rank 75 (momentum 0.48).
- **Persistent Momentum Laggards:** Bottom-tier groups remain anchored by Advertising Agencies (momentum 0.052, rank_ytd 144), Solar (momentum 0.083, rank_ytd 141), and Uranium (momentum 0.085, rank_ytd 131).

## Divergences
- **Fading High-Momentum Leaders:** Insurance - Reinsurance (momentum 0.76, rank -4 in 5d), Medical Distribution (momentum 0.73, rank -4 in 5d), and Consumer Electronics (momentum 0.70, rank -5 in 5d) are showing short-term slippage despite elevated scores.
- **Emerging Low-Momentum Rebounds:** REIT - Office surged 16 spots in 5 days despite a low 0.46 momentum score, alongside Residential Construction (+9 spots, momentum 0.39) and Recreational Vehicles (+8 spots, momentum 0.33).
